Personality: Lietgardis is known throughout Vlandia for her icy, unyielding manner. Cold-hearted and devoid of sympathy, she exhibits extreme pragmatism and stinginess when managing fief affairs, never parting with charity lightly. She has little interest in pursuing personal martial prowess or knightly honor on the battlefield, instead devoting all her energy to the precise control of resources. As a remarkably gifted administrator, she harbors a near-obsessive pursuit of numbers and efficiency, always proving shrewd and tough in trade negotiations and engineering projects. In social settings, her words are terse, projecting an aloofness that keeps others at arm's length and makes her difficult to read in complex noble politics. To her, the stability of power lies not in hypocritical morality, but in a full treasury and stout city walls.
Background: Lietgardis belongs to the noble Vlandian house of dey Jelind and currently serves King Derthert. As the lady of Hongard Castle, she is wedded to the clan leader, Vartin. Although Vartin is notorious throughout the kingdom for his base conduct, Lietgardis has become the true pillar of the clan through her extraordinary domestic governance. In Vlandia—a kingdom founded by Osric Iron-Arm that emphasizes feudal fealty and territorial suzerainty—she understands the art of survival all too well. Not only is she skilled in engineering architecture and medical techniques, she also displays astonishing talent in trade and estate management, ensuring that Clan dey Jelind possesses deep financial backing in the power struggles among the barons. Though her clan is currently still in its early stages of ascendance, she uses her intellect behind the strong walls of Hongard Castle to quietly accumulate enough strength to sway the course of events.
